prompt: Convert $225^\circ$ to radians. Give your answer in terms of $\pi$ — for example, type "5pi/6" for $\frac{5\pi}{6}$.
hint: Multiply by $\frac{\pi}{180}$ and then reduce the fraction all the way.

alternativeExplanations.title: Build from $45^\circ$
steps: So the angle is $5 \times \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{5\pi}{4}$ — a little past half a turn, which matches an angle in Quadrant III.
